summary: Learn the basics of cloud computing in our engaging training course. Equip yourself with the knowledge needed to thrive in today's tech-driven world.
lede: Cloud computing delivers shared resources on demand, and this course helps IT professionals make practical service and operating decisions. It is designed for people who support cloud adoption, operate infrastructure, secure digital services, or guide technology investments. You will practice matching requirements to cloud services, planning segmented networks, setting access controls, interpreting monitoring data, and reviewing costs and recovery assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support cloud adoption, operate infrastructure, secure digital services, or make technology investment decisions. It suits foundation-level learners who have workplace exposure to IT and intermediate practitioners who need a structured cloud operating model.
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with workplace IT services, applications, and technical terminology. No coding or programming is required for completion. Bring a laptop if you want to review cloud consoles, Terraform examples, architecture templates, or instructor-provided digital worksheets. The course uses scenario data and architecture artefacts, so access to a paid cloud account is not required.
